text:
### Mission  
Deliver responsive, empathetic customer support and resolve complaints efficiently.
name: Chunk 27/102

raw_entities.name: Customer Support Function
raw_entities.description: The organizational unit responsible for delivering responsive, empathetic customer support and resolving complaints efficiently. This function serves as the primary interface for customer issue resolution and complaint handling.
context: Deliver responsive, empathetic customer support and resolve complaints efficiently

raw_entities.name: Customer Complaint
raw_entities.description: A formal expression of dissatisfaction raised by a customer regarding the bank's products, services, or conduct. Complaints are subject to efficient resolution as part of the bank's customer support mission.

raw_entities.name: Responsive Customer Support Obligation
raw_entities.description: A governance requirement mandating that the bank deliver responsive and empathetic customer support. This operational obligation establishes the standard of care and responsiveness expected in customer interactions.

raw_entities.name: Efficient Complaint Resolution Obligation
raw_entities.description: A governance requirement mandating that the bank resolve customer complaints efficiently. This operational obligation establishes the expectation for timely and effective complaint handling.
